Least squares under masks from the W0 weights' forward (Γ reading the moved V′; E68's frozen-mask read, about 2.5 min a state) is printed beside the own-mask read, unscored.

rules.moved_part: What the subcomponents hold after least squares, U′V′ᵀ − UVᵀ = dσ(dU, dV) + dU dVᵀ with dU = X V, dV = Xᵀ U, X = K⁺δW (split.least_squares_x, plain, no Σ), the pieces rounded to fp32 as the forward applies them (qwen_maps.pieces). The remainder is δW minus it. E72's in-span (dσ alone) is read beside on anchor 2 seed 42 and in stage 0.
rules.1_clean: K(read) = KL(FT clean ‖ read clean) over every position of the arm's rows, fp32 forwards, fp64 sums. Ruler = K(W0). Holds if K(W0 + moved part) / ruler < clean_under; a tie misses. K(W0 + moved part) at or under at_floor nats reads 'at floor' (reported, not a miss). No call: ruler under ruler_floor or unread; or either bad placement (random: a Gaussian at each matrix's norm, seed 75100 + site index; signs: each matrix times a fixed random sign; E75 Amendment 1) does not read 'fails' by E75's rule (its K above the remainder's by more than the paired row bootstrap's half-width of the gap). Absolute against a ratio line.
rules.2_share: Share left in Δ = ‖δW − moved part‖² / ‖δW‖², plain, summed over the 196 matrices in fp64. Null = Σ_s (1 − rank U_s/n_s)(1 − rank V_s/m_s) ‖δW_s‖² / ‖δW‖² (split.gaussian_null of the live basis). Holds if null − share > the arm's seed spread |share(seed a) − share(seed b)|; one-seed arms (own-samples, u1, u2) borrow the null arm's spread, flagged. A tie misses. Relative to the null.
rules.3_size: Squared size = ‖moved part‖² / ‖δW‖², fp64. Holds at or under size_max; cannot fail least squares by much (about 1 minus the share), printed against 1 − share.
rules.4_kept_clean: Arms with a behaviour line (anchor 1, anchor 2, u1, u2; the RL, null and own-samples arms' gold-token gain is not their behaviour: 'no behaviour line'). E86's kept = (L(W0) − L(x)) / (L(W0) − L(FT)), L the mean response-token loss on the gain rows, no masks. Band from t = 0.1 (W0 + 0.1 δW): 'graded' at or under graded_at, 'saturated' at or over saturated_at, 'partly' between; no call under gain_min nats of gain or t = 1 off 1 by over t1_tol. Graded: holds if kept(W0 + moved part) >= kept(t = 0.5) of the same arm and job, else fails; a tie holds. Not graded: 'not graded', no line.
rules.5_K_masked: K under the state's own masks: KL(FT clean ‖ masked forward, Δ off), Γ on the state's weights reading its moved V′ (least squares, K11) against do-nothing (Γ on the state's weights, components as W0's, K01). Scored on whole-question answer positions of the anchor rows, pooled on maths rows (pooled printed beside). Holds if mean(K11 − K01) <= 2 x the paired row bootstrap half-width (2000 draws, seed 0); a tie holds; under min_rows rows, no call. Passes do-nothing by construction (E79): it can penalise harm, not credit placement.
rules.6_kept_masked: Graded arms with a behaviour line only. E68's gain, zero at masked W0: g(x) = Σ(nll_m00 − nll_x) / Σ(nll_W0 − nll_FT), same class as rule 5; under gain_min nats per position, no call. References from this job: do-nothing (own masks, components as W0's), ceiling (do-nothing's masks plus the whole δW, E72), random (a Gaussian at δW's norm per matrix placed by least squares, Γ on W0 + it and its moved V′). w = paired row half-width of g(ls) − g(do-nothing). Room (E72): ceiling − do-nothing > room_min and > 2w, else 'no room'. With room, E72's label with no rarely-on half: 'fails' at or under max(do-nothing, random) + w, 'passes' at or over ceiling − w, 'partial' between.
rules.verdict: A state fails if 1, 2, 3 or 5 misses or 4 or 6 reads 'fails'. It passes if 1 holds or is at floor and 2, 3, 5 hold (with 'no behaviour line', 'not graded' or 'no room' reported beside); otherwise no call, or pending while a read is missing. An arm fails if either seed fails, passes if every seed passes. Least squares passes the table if every arm passes; it fails it if any arm fails, and teacher training toward TOFU follows. Ratios round to 9 places before comparing.
rules.printed: Per state, unscored: K of W0 masked, do-nothing, least squares and least squares under the W0 weights' masks, and the three kept under masks, on the scored class and pooled; E72's in-span on anchor 2 seed 42; on u1, the share and null on the bf16 file E91 read (the bf16 floor); size against 1 − share; seconds per read.
